# Ashcombe Water — telemetry journal

One line per event: <timestamp> <LEVEL> <probe> writer=<writer> <message>. Every writer stamps British Summer Time (UTC+1) except the roaming probe hyd-roam, whose clock is set to UTC. To place an event on the UTC timeline, shift every other writer's stamp back by one hour. A pump stall alarm is an ERROR whose message opens with 'pump stall'. Banner lines open with === and are not events.
